svg.title: Virtual nodes (vnodes)
svg.desc: Multiple token positions per physical node improve statistical balance and make ownership movement more granular—not perfectly uniform.
svg.text: Multiple token positions per physical node improve statistical balance and make ownership movement more granular—not perfectly uniform.
A single position creates large, uneven ownership intervals.
All 64 token positions per node are shown schematically; ownership shares are illustrative.
More vnode positions reduce variance, but
64 per node is not a guarantee of 25% exactly.
Vnode count trades balance granularity against token metadata, repair/streaming work, and operational complexity.
